head: 2f082fd40
summary: Verified 8.0/10, ON PAR (ruling 8): no blocker or major found or reproduced. The reviewer's reports (fw_W1_combat_polish_closing_combat2.json, _hold2.json, closing_combat2_hue.json, closing_combat2_kits.json) match its claims: hue 64/64, minSig 0.527, maxTeamLight 0.296. Ult core is x2.06-2.69 and Lisvel's body reads 0.318 white in the full frame. On 5 ults (hesmi, lisvel, marund, nurrow, vashil) the struck body's detail drops to 0.24-0.34. I ran a third hold probe (`node _harness/probe_combat_polish.mjs hold --tag closing_combat2_v3`, _harness/_reports/fw_W1_combat_polish_closing_combat2_v3.json). Tunlan's disc held 167 ms (PASS) and Kemdo 267 / Rishal 233 ms, so Tunlan's hold passes in 2 of 3 runs, exactly at the bar: CF2-1 minor confirmed. CF2-4 is real, but the reviewer described it wrongly. The green orb does not stay in place: it drifts slowly toward the victim from 433 to 800 ms, and its position does not match the dart's hit at about 600 ms (cropped frames f13-f21 of closing_combat2_kit_ulkro_a1.jpg). The white burst at f11-f15 is another unit's hit, not the dart's. Load was 28-43 during my run, so frame timing is not measured.

gapStatus.evidence: Aim sheets _harness/_shots/closing_combat2_aim_{vashil,ervet,odrum,ardit,ulkro}.jpg exist. The live kit sheets (e.g. closing_combat2_kit_ardit_ult.jpg f0, kit_ulkro_a1.jpg f0) show the indicator from f0.
Agree with the reviewer. Ardit ult shows the enemy edge and fill from f0 (closing_combat2_kit_ardit_ult.jpg).
fw_W1_combat_polish_closing_combat2.json cc: labels go from 14 to 21, alpha 0.24/0.48/0.71/0.95 at 33-83 ms.
Reviewer's content and live antic counts (closing_combat2_kits.json). Ulkro a1 shows a green release wind-up at f1-f9.
The hold is on the edge. Tunlan's disc held 100 / 167 / 167 ms over 3 runs (closing_combat2.json FAIL, _hold2 PASS, _v3 PASS by my run). Kemdo 233-267 and Rishal 167-233 ms. Wind-up timing is closed.
Reviewer's flashMax figures. Victim flashes are visible in the kit sheets.
closing_combat2_hue.json: slots 64, measured 64, passed 64, minSig 0.527, maxTeamLight 0.296.

Per-ult first-beat ratio, from my read of fw_W1_combat_polish_closing_combat2.json:
- Range 2.06 (Dunsom, second beat 1.92) to 2.69 (Ulkro).
- Hesmi: full-frame body white 0.055.
- Lisvel: 0.318, box 0.215.
- Vashil box 0.318 and Ardit box 0.305, both at or under 0.35.
Reviewer's own-death grade series. The kill banner is not measured.
Reviewer: 0 shake layers, camJitter 0. Not contradicted.
Ardit ult sheet f11-f65 shows a distortion shimmer and secondary shapes (ground cracks, edge arc, sky column).

findings.title: Basic-hit impact hold is on the bar's edge (Tunlan)
findings.what: Tunlan's disc held at least 0.5x the victim for 100 ms in 1 run and 167 ms in 2 runs (bar 167 ms).
findings.evidence: fw_W1_combat_polish_closing_combat2.json gives 100 ms (FAIL). _hold2.json gives 167 ms, and my run _v3.json also gives 167 ms (disc 0.9/0.93/0.82/0.61/0.53/0.37).
findings.gauge: r12 M5: a starburst about 0.7x the victim's height holds for about 200 ms on every basic hit.
findings.fix: Give the shared magic and light hit defs and Tunlan's hit a slower second chalk-white disc, so the hold clears 167 ms with margin.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced the edge with a third run: it passes at exactly 167 ms, with no margin. It stays a minor because the item is at 8 and a 1-frame variance is not a blocker.

findings.title: 5 ultimates flatten the struck body for the full 2-frame allowance; Lisvel 0.318 white
findings.what: Five ults drop the victim's internal detail below 0.5 for 2 frames: Hesmi, Lisvel, Marund, Nurrow and Vashil.
findings.evidence:
fw_W1_combat_polish_closing_combat2.json ult[].beats detail on the first 2 beats:
- hesmi 0.29/0.32
- lisvel 0.30/0.42
- marund 0.24/0.35
- nurrow 0.34/0.42
- vashil 0.27/0.31
Lisvel bodyWhiteFull 0.318.
findings.gauge: r12 M13: ultimates win on value range and size; the struck champion stays readable through the beat.
findings.fix: Ground or depth-test the dense core sprite, cap the victim flash on ult beats, and ring Marund's dome outward.
findings.verifierNote: The numbers match the report. It is within the 2-frame allowance, so it is backlog only.

findings.title: Long enemy zones hold a heavy orange fill over the caster's signature art
findings.what: For the full duration, Ardit's ultimate zone reads mostly orange with a violet overlay.
findings.evidence: _harness/_shots/closing_combat2_kit_ardit_ult.jpg f11-f65: orange fill over most of the frame, with violet cracks and the column on top.
findings.gauge: Persistent danger zones in LoL keep a clear edge and let the zone's art carry the body.
findings.fix: After a zone lands and lasts over 1 s, lower its enemy fill to about 8% and keep the edge.
findings.verifierNote: Seen in the sheet. It is a readability-versus-identity trade-off; Ardit's violet is still visible on top, so it stays a minor.

findings.title: Ulkro Hurl: a green orb drifts out of step with the dart's hit
findings.what: A green orb with a ring drifts slowly from in front of Ulkro toward the victim between 433 and 800 ms. The dart's hit spark lands on the victim at about 600 ms while the orb is still short of it. It does not stay in place, as the reviewer said; it is a slow visual that lags or doubles the dart.
findings.evidence: Crop of f13-f21 from _harness/_shots/closing_combat2_kit_ulkro_a1.jpg (scratch ulkro_row2.jpg). The white burst at the victim at f11-f15 is another unit's hit, not Hurl's. Hurl is projectile speed 30, range 10, pierce 0 (content/fighters/ulkro.json a1).
findings.gauge: LoL skillshot visuals match the hitbox and end on impact.
findings.fix: Bind the orb or head layer to the projectile position and end it on the hit event. Check with ab_frames on the ulkro_a1_hurl layers.
findings.verifierNote: Real, but the reviewer's description (stuck orb) is inaccurate. It was not traced to a layer, so it stays a minor.

findings.title: Recall channel builds little before the final column
findings.what: The ring grows from about 6.6k to 16.9k px over the channel, with a column only at the end.
findings.gauge: LoL's recall builds visibly toward completion.
findings.fix: A VALE dial-rite plate whose hour-line sweeps in the fighter's signature hue over the channel.
findings.verifierNote: Not re-captured; the report series supports it. It is a polish minor.

notMeasured: Frame timing: load was 28-43 during verification.
